# NTD

> > NTD is a global media organization providing breaking news coverage and hosting international competitions in classical arts, dance, and martial arts.

NTD (New Tang Dynasty) operates both as a news network covering U.S. politics, international affairs, and current events, and as an organizer of cultural competitions celebrating traditional arts. The platform serves audiences seeking independent journalism and participants in classical arts competitions.

## Key Topics

- NTD Competitions
- NTD News
- Breaking news coverage
- U.S. politics
- International affairs
- Middle East events
- Classical arts
- Dance competitions
- Martial arts
- Trump administration
- Federal Reserve
- Military operations
- Public health
- Legal proceedings
- Traditional culture

## News & Current Events

- [NTD News - Breaking News, Latest News and Videos](https://cms.ntd.com/): NTD News homepage featuring breaking news, politics, and international events

## Competitions & Registration

- [NTD Competitions Online Application](https://reg.ntd.com/): NTD Competitions registration for dance, martial arts, and art contests
